icons.name: Coiled Shooter
icons.concept: Solid Signal-Red full-figure silhouette sunk into a low staggered ready-stance, head ducked and lead arm reaching to level-change, with a gold coiled-energy seam down the back.

icons.name: Hex Cutout Stance
icons.concept: Heavy red hexagon plate with the low staggered wrestler stance carved out as a Void negative-space figure, topped by a single gold energy notch on the edge.

icons.name: Poster Crest Stance
icons.concept: Inverted palette fight-poster badge: bold Terminal-White wrestler in a wide planted crouch on a Void panel inside a heavy frame, over a dominant red field with a gold belt line.

icons.name: Classic Singlet
icons.concept: Front-view wrestling singlet in Signal Red with deep V-neck straps, white side stripes, gold waistband, and leg cutouts on Void.

icons.name: E-Singlet
icons.concept: Continuous-strap singlet with the brand E (rising bars + gold peak) emblazoned across the chest on Void.

icons.name: Rated Flat-Lay
icons.concept: Inverted palette: a Void singlet flat-lay on a Signal Red field with a bold geometric '1024' rating number, last digit in gold, across the chest.

icons.name: Front Cradle
icons.concept: Front-on wrestling headgear: white head dome flanked by two heavy red ear cups, crown and chin straps, gold buckle.

icons.name: Cup Hero
icons.concept: Single massive ear-guard cup as a Void shield on a Signal Red field, with radiating white anchor straps and gold studs.

icons.name: Profile Wrap
icons.concept: Side-profile white head wearing one bold red ear cup with crown and chin straps wrapping around it, gold buckle accent.

icons.name: Drive In
icons.concept: A red shooter silhouette drops its level and drives forward-left into the opponent's white legs, drive legs exploding off the mat with a gold penetration spark at contact.

icons.name: Level Change
icons.concept: Pure directional force: a descending chevron stack into a massive forward drive-arrow that penetrates a white opponent post, gold arrowhead marking the breakthrough.

icons.name: The Clamp
icons.concept: The finish of the shot: heavy red arms lock around both white legs in a horseshoe clinch while a forward drive wedge launches off the floor, gold spark at the tipping point.

icons.name: Top Pin
icons.concept: Red dominant wrestler flattening a white opponent into the red mat — classic top-position pin silhouette.

icons.name: The Slap
icons.concept: Referee's open red hand striking the mat as a white figure lies pinned, gold impact marks — the moment of the fall.

icons.name: The Press
icons.concept: Heavy downward double-chevron driving a flattened white figure into the red floor, gold impact burst — the pin as raw force.

icons.name: Restart Mat
icons.concept: Top-down concentric wrestling mat with a Signal Red center restart cross and a gold center hub.

icons.name: Face-Off Zone
icons.concept: Bold red boundary ring with two opposing wrestler chevrons converging across a gold center clash mark.

icons.name: Mat Gauge
icons.concept: The mat circle as a rating gauge: heavy red sweep ring, rising white needle, and a gold breakthrough peak notch.
